question: Does manual (17 features) lose at most 0.005 absolute NDCG@10 against all (47 features) on P20 development queries?
rationale: Operational questions chosen after inspecting previous development pilots; one bounded reproduction/extension batch, not new independent confirmation. The tolerance is chosen for this study, not a domain constant.

estimand.interval: 95% paired user-cluster bootstrap; conditional descriptive development uncertainty
estimand.evidence_boundary: Pilot-informed and development-only; already seen pilot and historical overnight outputs. No preregistration, blind confirmation, independent sample or final-test claim.

decision_rule.inconclusive: otherwise; crossing or touching -0.005 does not establish inferiority or equivalence
decision_rule.cost_boundary: Compare measured fit/application/process costs. The full dictionary is constructed upstream for every method; no feature-construction saving follows from selected column count.
